description: Fork of exp115 (MHLut+smooth_mode=True+n_alternatives=1) adding a per-layer ffn_lut after the attention sublayer with classic skip residual + LayerNorm. Block forward: attn_out = LN(out_proj(attn(x)) + x); ffn_out = ffn_lut(attn_out); return LN(ffn_out + attn_out). ffn_lut uses the same SparseLut config as out_proj (input E, n_heads=1, n_outputs=E, nap=8, tph=2048, n_sparse_outputs=8). E=384, d_qk=32, d_v=64, all other settings from exp115 unchanged.
